glosses: to ooze, to exude, to secrete
to separate from a larger whole

examples.text: Zgodnie z nią [tj. definicją Sądu Najwyższego] budynkiem jest ... odrębny od gruntu przedmiot własności ... wydzielony z przestrzeni za pomocą przegród budowlanych, posiadający fundamenty oraz dach...
examples.translation: According to it [i.e., the Supreme Court's definition], an item of property separate from the ground, ... separated from the [surrounding] space using constructed partitions, having a foundation as well as a roof, ... is a building...
examples.english: According to it [i.e., the Supreme Court's definition], an item of property separate from the ground, ... separated from the [surrounding] space using constructed partitions, having a foundation as well as a roof, ... is a building...
